subject.title: [Feature]: Session busy status reply + cancel option during long-running model responses

question: Should OpenClaw add a generic busy-session acknowledgement by default, make it opt-in/configurable, and which portable cancel/new-session actions plus busy reason fields should be part of that contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but visible status text, configuration/defaults, and cross-channel cancel/new actions change shared messaging UX and compatibility expectations.

options.title: Conservative default acknowledgement
options.body: Add a short default busy acknowledgement with no destructive action by default, then expose typed optional cancel/new-session actions only where channels can render them safely.

options.title: Opt-in queue configuration
options.body: Add the same core contract behind explicit `messages.queue` configuration so existing deployments preserve silent enqueue behavior unless operators enable it.

options.title: Channel-local UX only
options.body: Keep core enqueue behavior unchanged and let channel/plugin owners implement local busy UX, accepting inconsistent behavior across channels.

recommendation.title: Conservative default acknowledgement
recommendation.body: Add a short default busy acknowledgement with no destructive action by default, then expose typed optional cancel/new-session actions only where channels can render them safely.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for queue policy, queued-followup behavior, and prior review context points to steipete.
